Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, plastic, and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Material: Wood, Plastic, and Metal. Colour: Green. Product measurements: length 70 cm, width 70 cm, height 120 cm. Product weight: 1.5 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its red finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Reusable design allows for repeated use and easy storage between occasions.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif to create a festive focal point.
Vibrant red finish coordinates easily with existing holiday displays.

Suitable for Indoor use

Build your own Christmas countdown with this set of 192 round Advent stickers. Each sheet carries the numbers 1 to 24, and the pack holds 8 sheets, so there is plenty for a full Advent calendar plus spares for cards, tags and envelopes.

The stickers are printed with festive motifs including Santa, a snowman, a Christmas tree, a penguin, snowflakes, a reindeer, a gnome, angel wings, a gingerbread man, stockings and bells. Every design sits alongside its number, which makes counting down the days to Christmas Eve quick and clear for children. The same numbers repeat across the sheets, so you can build one large calendar or several small ones.

Each sticker is made from quality coated paper with a layer of bright colour film, so it is water resistant, does not rust or fade and holds firmly once pressed down. The self-adhesive backing needs no glue or tape, and every round sticker measures 4 cm (1.57 in) across, a good size for paper bags, boxes and cards.

Use them to make a personalised Advent calendar, to seal gift boxes, envelopes and party bags, or to decorate Christmas cards, gift tags and craft projects. Children can stick a number on each day, fill paper bags with small treats and finish the set on Christmas Eve.

A practical alternative to a chocolate Advent calendar and a fun stocking filler for girls and boys. Pack contents: 8 sheets, 192 stickers, 1 to 24 numbering, 4 cm diameter.

Christmas Tree Skirt
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056141085203.sourceDescription:
Bring a candy-inspired detail to your Christmas tree with this 15cm multicolour snowflake ornament. Each decoration measures 15 x 15 x 2cm and combines a branching snowflake outline with a multicoloured sequin surface. The textured design adds interest among plain baubles and ribbons, giving your tree a sweet-shop theme while retaining a familiar winter shape. A hanging loop provides a way to display each snowflake on a suitable branch or incorporate it into a decorative wreath or garland. Position the ornament where the outline can be seen clearly, then pair it with your own candy-cane decorations, bows and other seasonal accessories. The multicolour design is also suited to indoor window arrangements, winter wonderland party displays and festive home decorating. Use the single piece as a focal accent among other ornaments. This option includes 1 snowflake decoration. The candy-style finish is decorative and the ornaments are not edible. Pair with your chosen festive colour scheme.
Candy Snowflake Decorations: Includes 1 x 15cm multicolour candy-style snowflake ornament. Each piece measures 15 x 15 x 2cm and has a branching snowflake outline with a multicoloured sequin surface, bringing a sweet-shop theme to Christmas trees and festive home displays.
Textured Festive Finish: Small coloured sequins cover the branching snowflake shape, creating a textured finish with red, green and gold tones. This pattern adds visual interest beside plain baubles, ribbons and greenery, making the ornament a useful accent for a themed Christmas tree or an indoor winter display.
Hanging Ornament Design: Use the hanging loop to position each 15cm snowflake on a suitable branch, wreath or garland. Leave room around the branching shape to show its outline and textured detail, then combine with your own Christmas decorations to build a coordinated arrangement.
Winter Wonderland Theme: Combine these multicolour snowflake decorations with candy-cane ornaments, bows and other seasonal accents for a sweet-inspired tree. Their familiar winter shape also suits Christmas window displays, festive party backdrops and decorative wreath arrangements indoors.
Pack And Display Details: Contains 1 snowflake for a single decorative accent, with a 15cm outline and 2cm depth. Combine with your own tree accessories, ribbon and foliage for a themed arrangement. These candy-inspired ornaments are decorative and are not edible sweets.

5061134114303.sourceDescription:
Create a beautiful festive atmosphere with these 540 LED cluster Christmas lights featuring a combination of warm white and ruby red illumination. Designed with closely spaced LEDs at approximately 1 cm intervals, these decorative lights produce a dense and sparkling effect for Christmas trees, bushes, garlands, railings, wreaths and other decorations. The flexible silver pin wire makes them easy to wrap, shape and position around different surfaces. Featuring 8 lighting functions, you can choose from a variety of lighting effects to suit your festive display. The built in timer automatically switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, providing convenient daily operation. Supplied with a 5 metre transparent leading cable and BS IP20 transformer, these cluster lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor seasonal decorating when the transformer is kept in a dry protected location.
540 LED Cluster Lights – Features 540 bright LEDs in warm white and ruby red colours, creating a rich and attractive festive display.
Dense Cluster Design – Approximately 1 cm LED spacing provides fuller coverage and a sparkling illuminated effect for Christmas decorations.
Warm White and Ruby Red Lighting – Combines two attractive lighting colours to bring warmth and festive character to your home and garden.
Lighting Functions – Offers 8 different lighting effects, allowing you to customise your Christmas decorations.
Automatic Timer Function – Built-in timer operates for 6 hours on and 18 hours off for convenient daily lighting.
Flexible Silver Wire – Flexible silver pin wire makes wrapping and positioning around trees, bushes, garlands and railings easy.
5 Metre Leading Cable – Includes a transparent 5 metre power cable for convenient installation and flexible positioning.
Indoor and Outdoor Decoration – Ideal for Christmas trees, wreaths, shrubs, bannisters, patios, porches and seasonal party displays.

8956086258403.sourceDescription:
Add a festive finishing touch to your Christmas table with this pack of 30 mini Santa hats. Each hat is made from soft velvet cloth that feels comfortable to the touch, is non-polluting and safe to use around the home, and keeps its shape when slipped over the neck of a bottle. At approximately 6 x 12 cm (2.2 x 4.7 in) they fit standard wine and drinks bottles neatly and stay in place while you set the table.

The set is an easy way to dress a drinks table, buffet or Christmas dinner setting. Slide one over each bottle to turn an ordinary bottle into part of the decorations, or use them to tie the table styling together with the rest of your festive scheme. Because they are small and light, the hats also work on dolls, soft toys and craft projects, can be hung on the Christmas tree, or tucked along a shelf or mantelpiece for a warm Christmas feel.

Each hat is handmade, so please allow a small tolerance of around 2 mm in size between pieces. The pack of 30 gives you enough to cover a full drinks selection, share with family and friends, or keep a few spare for next year. The hats can be used again and again, so one pack sees you through Christmas dinner, Boxing Day drinks and the parties in between.
Guarantee - 1 month

8956086362803.variantName: Glowing Christmas Door Hanger, Lighted Door Hanger, D Style, Rustic Front Door Decor, 5 Festive Designs with Warm Glow
8956086362803.sourceDescription:
The front door is where the Christmas welcome starts, and this lighted hanger handles it with a handcrafted Santa face topper and a spiral of warm white LED lights running down its length. Crochet details, a knitted hat and scarf, little stockings and floral accents give it the handmade character that printed decorations never manage, and golden jingle bells with a red bow finish the bottom.

It hangs vertically on doors, walls and entryways, glowing softly rather than glaring, which suits both a hallway and a sheltered porch. Being decorative lighting, it is happiest indoors or under cover, where the weather cannot argue with it.

Guests notice it before they notice anything else, which is precisely the point of a door decoration.

Material: Fabric and crochet with LED lights
Handcrafted Santa topper with crochet hat and scarf
Warm white LED spiral glows down the whole hanger
Bells and a red bow finish the design
Hangs vertically on doors, walls and entryways
Best displayed indoors or under a sheltered porch

Product Overview

 This handmade autumn wreath is a classic fall harvest decoration, densely decorated with mixed artificial pumpkins, pinecones, orange sunflowers, eucalyptus leaves, maple leaves and berry clusters. 
 Rich rustic earth tones bring warm harvest style, ideal for front door, wall, fireplace and seasonal home decor for Autumn, Thanksgiving and Halloween.

Specifications

 Diameter: 18 inch / 46 cm
 Inner frame diameter: 11 inch / 28 cm
 Package: 1 wreath per pack
 Material: Fabric leaves & flowers, foam pumpkins, natural pinecones, plastic berries, twig woven base
 Style: Fall / Harvest / Thanksgiving rustic wreath
 Note: No built-in LED lights

Application Scenarios
Front door, porch, entryway, fireplace mantel, indoor wall, garden fence, farmhouse decor, Thanksgiving, Halloween, autumn party and shop window display.
Notes

 For longer service life, place in covered area; avoid prolonged heavy rain and strong direct sunlight.
 Other decorative props in scene pictures (pumpkins, candles, ghost ornaments etc.) are not included, only the autumn wreath is delivered.
【Exquisite Craftsmanship & High Fidelity】Every detail of this fall wreath is meticulously designed, offering a lifelike touch with intricate textures and rich autumn - themed accessories. Its visually striking appearance makes it a standout piece in Thanksgiving decor. As a true masterpiece, it effortlessly elevates your indoor or outdoor autumn decor, capturing the essence of the harvest season with its realistic elements and timeless elegance.
【Sturdy Base and Solid Accessories】Meticulously crafted, this fall wreath features a robust base and durable accessories, each component securely fastened to withstand the elements and ensure long-lasting use. Ideal for farmhouse fall decor, it adds warmth and elegance to your front door or indoor space. More than just a decorative piece, it serves as a steadfast symbol of resilience within autumn decor, combining functionality with timeless beauty that enhances any fall home decor setting.
【Versatile Decor】This autumn pumpkin wreath measures 18 inch/46 cm. Perfect size for front door, indoor, outdoor, wall, window, porch, fireplace or above the mantle in your home as a warm inviting welcome sign to your family and friends. Note that a deviation of 2~3cm may occur due to manual measurement.
【Safe Wreaths】With no sharp edges, this autumn pumpkin wreath offers a worry-free way to bring the beauty of autumn into your home. Embrace the season with peace of mind and elegance.
【Autumn Vibe】This amazing pumpkin wreath could be used during Halloween, autumn Harvest Day and Thanksgiving Day to add a little holiday touch and warmth to your home. Eye-catching design makes your decorations stand out in the neighborhood.

5313817009803.sourceDescription:
Product Description

 This pre-lit Christmas garland features realistic frosted pine branches, decorated with natural pinecones and bright red berries, creating a classic snowy winter festive atmosphere. 
 Two versions are available: pre-decorated with warm white light string or plain garland without lights. 
 It comes in 3 different lengths to fit various decorating needs, perfect for indoor holiday decor.

Product Specifications

 Available Length: 1.5m / 1.8m / 2.7m
 2 Options for selection:
 1. With light version: Comes with 5m 50LED warm white light string, powered by 3 AA battery box. Batteries NOT included
 2. No light version: Plain decorative garland without light string
 Material: PVC pine needles, artificial pine cone & red berry ornaments
 Features: Bendable branches, you can freely shape and arrange the garland as you want. Frosted snow-sprayed surface for realistic snow effect.

Application Scenarios
Ideal for decorating dining table centerpieces, fireplace mantels, stair handrails, door frames, archways, shop window displays, wedding and party backdrop. Great for Christmas, winter holiday and seasonal home decoration.
Notes

 The battery operated light string requires 3 AA batteries, batteries are not included in package.
 The garland branches are compressed for shipping, gently separate and fluff up the pine tips after unpacking for fuller look.
 For indoor use only, avoid long-term exposure to heavy rain or extreme humid environment.
5' LIFELIKE SNOWY CHRISTMAS GARLAND: 200 PVC life-like pine needle branches with decorative pinecones create the natural snowy look of a real Christmas garland for a timeless holiday accessory
REALISTIC APPEARANCE: Features snowy pine needles that stimulates a realistic feel to deliver a perfect touch of festive ambiance even if a white Christmas is not on the forecast
VERSATILE DISPLAY: Can be hung up or draped on banisters, walls, fireplace mantles, or other surfaces either indoors or in covered areas outdoor
SAFER FRESH-CUT ALTERNATIVE: Flame-retardant, hypoallergenic, and needle-shed resistant so you can welcome in friends and family for the holidays without worry
Perfect for Holiday Season: Add charm to your Christmas holiday with this eye-catching snow flocked 5' Christmas garland greenery. Create a festival environment suitable for Christmas, Hotels, Shopping malls, Party, Bars, Store Gate and Window; Garland for stairs railing
Guarantee - 1 month

[Indoor and Outdoor Christmas Decoration] Place the IP44 waterproof garland on your front door or window to welcome your friends, or hang it on the fireplace, mantel or sofa to bring a festive atmosphere to the whole family. An excellent Christmas gift for someone special. Perfect for New Year, Valentine's Day, weddings, parties and other celebrations.
Christmas garlands suit indoor and outdoor decoration, and their flexible shape is very easy to craft. Give them all kinds of favorite shapes and your family and friends will be very satisfied.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Product measurements: height 33 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive snowflake detail design adds a decorative focal point to your Christmas display.
Durable plastic construction ensures longevity for seasonal home ornamentation.
Versatile styling allows easy integration with existing colour schemes and textures.
Compact 33 cm height makes it suitable for various indoor display positions.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Place on a stable surface away from heat sources or open flames. Ensure the decoration is securely positioned to prevent it from falling and breaking.
Shatterproof

2313817175303.sourceDescription:
Product Description:

 Style and Package Note: Bead colors, toppers, hanging charms and seasonal details vary according to the selected design. Please review the chosen variation and package information before ordering to confirm the style and included components match
 the project you want to create.
 Turn Craft Time Into a Festive Centerpiece: Create a decorative tree filled with colorful beads, miniature ornaments and dimensional detail. The layered branch shape gives the finished piece a full sculptural appearance, while hanging bead accents
 create movement and sparkle. Unlike a flat craft project, the completed tree becomes a display-ready decoration that can add instant personality to a mantel, shelf, desk or holiday table.
 Enjoy a Rewarding Creative Process: Build the design step by step and enjoy watching individual beads and charms become a dimensional tree. The repetitive placement process offers relaxing hands-on time, while each completed section provides a visible
 sense of progress. It is an enjoyable project for quiet evenings, weekend crafting or sharing creative time with family and friends.


Production Specifications:
Size: 12 x 20cm
Material: Plastic
Style: Vintage Halloween

Package Includes:
DIY Beaded Christmas Tree Kit x 1

Please Note:
1. Small beads included. Not suitable for children under 3 years.
2. DIY kit, self‑assembly of all beads & decorations needed.
3. Minor colour difference on beads may exist, not a defect.
4. Requires button batteries (batteries included); for indoor‑use only.
The product requires self-assembly; it is not a finished product. Complete beaded tree set: Includes colorful beads, green branch pieces, decorative ornament charms, metal support parts, an angel topper, a round display base, and a light string, giving you the main materials needed to build a detailed tabletop christmas tree.
Clear layer-by-layer assembly: Sort the beads, thread the branch sections, attach the hanging charms, and arrange each layer around the center frame. The structured crafting process helps beginners follow the project while leaving room to adjust the ornament placement.
Sparkling seasonal details: Crystal-style beads, pearl-like accents, gold-tone elements, and multicolor pendants reflect nearby light and create a rich, dimensional appearance. The angel topper and cascading bead branches give the finished tree a recognizable festive silhouette
Compact tabletop decoration: Display the completed tree on a mantel, coffee table, office desk, bookshelf, entryway console, dining table, or bedroom dresser. Its compact format adds christmas character to smaller spaces without requiring room for a full-size tree
Craft activity and display piece: Designed for adults, craft enthusiasts, friends, and family members who enjoy hands-on seasonal projects. The recipient can enjoy the building process first, then use the completed beaded tree as part of their holidaydecoration year after year.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

5059442168903.sourceDescription:
If you're looking for the ideal real Christmas tree, the Noble Fir is up there with the best you can buy. Well known for it's bright green needles that display a bluish-hue with a lovely scent, providing extremely attractive foliage that won't drop it's needles. The hardy upright branches allow for even the heaviest ornaments to be easily supported.
